R1 — Diff adds format as parser-owned option, keeps it in directive params, and resolveDataDirectives reads it for expansion.; R2 — format was added to parser-owned option keys and resolveDataDirectives passes extractUserParams(d.params) to resolveFn, excluding format from DataSource params.; R3 — Omitted format defaults to table, and format "table" calls toMarkdownFormat, which delegates to the existing toMarkdown() path.; R4 — Table.toMarkdownFormat('list') delegates to toMarkdownList(), which requires exactly two columns and renders each row as '- first-column: second-column'.; R5 — Non-Table Renderables throw an explicit format/Table error for list format, and Table list rendering throws an explicit 2-column Table error when labels length is not 2.; R6 — Unsupported values are passed through assertMarkdownFormat, which throws an explicit error including the unsupported value string.; R7 — Format resolution and rendering were added inside shared resolveDataDirectives, so all existing callers receive the same behavior.; R8 — Diff adds spec-local and shared unit tests covering format filtering, default/explicit table rendering, two-column list rendering, non-Table and non-two-column list errors, and unsupported format errors.; Spec Test Coverage — The diff adds spec-local coverage under specs/262-data-format-list/tests/ with a non-empty // spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 header, and also updates shared unit tests.; Avoid Overengineering — function resolveDataFormat(params) — This introduces a helper/indirection layer that is only called once in the added diff. The guardrail prohibits indirection layers that have a single caller. (at src/docs/lib/directive-parser.js); Avoid Overengineering — function renderResolvedData(resolved, format) — This introduces a helper/indirection layer that is only called once in the added diff. The guardrail prohibits indirection layers that have a single caller. (at src/docs/lib/directive-parser.js); Avoid Overengineering — function assertTwoColumnListTable(table) — This introduces a helper/indirection layer that is only called once in the added diff. The guardrail prohibits indirection layers that have a single caller. (at src/docs/lib/renderable.js)
fix: removed single-caller helpers flagged by no-overengineering
entries.resolution: Inlined resolveDataFormat and renderResolvedData in resolveDataDirectives, and inlined assertTwoColumnListTable inside Table.toMarkdownList while keeping shared assertMarkdownFormat for the multi-call format contract.
